column1: # Black/Matrix AD - English script: Chapter 3 Pandemonium gladiator district
# offset<TAB>english      The pixel-aware wrapper supplies layout.

column2: Listen, buddy! When buying a $$人券$$, the key is who did the breeding!!
And which $$繁殖奴隷$$ is used is another key point...
You there, chestnut-haired one!
You look like you've got plenty of stamina and some fine muscles...
Heh heh... So, what do you say? Want to try $$剣闘$$ with me?!
I can introduce you to a fine $$肌奴隷$$, if you want!
The trick to spotting a strong $$剣闘士$$ is to start by judging how taut their muscles are!
Then check for $$コズミ$$, tremors, sweating, and dizziness! That's the proper way!
Hey... Don't tell me you're...?!
The legendary $$七冠人$$ who retired a few years ago...
Shut up! It has nothing to do with you, so beat it!
What? You want to know where this city's $$領主$$ is...?
Obviously in the VIP room where the $$剣闘士$$ owners gather, right?!
You sure look beat-up...
But don't go dropping scraps everywhere just because you're dressed in rags...
What is it!? If you want a prediction for the next match, buy this $$週刊剣闘士新聞$$!!
If you want private coaching, well...
I'll teach you for double the prize money you stand to win...!
Oh, welcome!
So!? Which $$剣闘士$$'s $$人券$$ are you planning to buy...?!
Don't do it!!
There is no cheating in this gambling, but they add an outrageous $$テラ銭$$ instead...
A $$テラ銭$$!?
Yeah, it's like a venue fee deducted from gambling payouts...!
In other words, whether you win or lose...
They have it set up so the customers do not come out ahead in the end...
(I wanted to try it...)
Heh heh heh...
Welcome!
Who are you people...? Beyond here are the VIP room and the contestants' waiting rooms,
so armed people are not permitted through...
Or are you contestants in the next match, perhaps?!
That's right, we're contestants!!
Nothing like that!
Heh heh heh, you fools... In that case, you may pass!!
